name: Seated Marching

instructions.description: Sit tall near the front of a stable chair.
Lift one knee without leaning far backward.
Lower the foot and alternate sides.
Continue with a smooth rhythm and relaxed breathing.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record average movement or step cadence.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

variations.variationDescription: Seated Marching — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.

commentsNotes: Use a stable chair without wheels.
